blocks.text: Effective solutions often integrate more than one emerging technology. Combining AI's intelligence, IoT's connectivity, Cloud's scalability, and Blockchain's security can create powerful, data-driven systems. This integration leads to smarter applications that not only solve problems but also adapt and improve over time.

A smart irrigation system can use IoT sensors to measure soil moisture, AI algorithms to predict crop water needs, and Cloud storage to collect and analyze data. This helps farmers optimize water use, reduce costs, and increase yields. Such integrated systems demonstrate how technology collaboration can support sustainable agriculture and environmental conservation in Pakistan.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Form mixed groups (technology, social science, business). Design a collaborative project that uses technology to solve a community issue.
